cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we're starting an exciting series of tutorials on Docker and containerization.
cues.zh: 今天開始 Docker 與容器化系列。

cues.en: So previously we spoke about virtualization, and that's a process of sharing hardware.
cues.zh: 先前談虛擬化，也就是共用硬體。

cues.en: The way it works is we've got hardware, then on top of that, there's a host operating system managed by AWS, which we never see.
cues.zh: 有硬體，上面是 AWS 管理、我們看不到的主機作業系統。

cues.en: It's completely behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 完全在背後。

cues.en: There's a hypervisor, which we also don't see.
cues.zh: 還有看不到的 Hypervisor。

cues.en: But then on top of that, we are provided with, for example, EC2 instances, and we can install our own software on there
cues.zh: 再上面提供 EC2 等，可安裝軟體，

cues.en: or do whatever we want on them.
cues.zh: 或做想做的事。

cues.en: So for example, we will install an operating system called the Guest operating system on our EC2 instance, and then on top of that, we will install some applications
cues.zh: 例如 EC2 上安裝稱為客體作業系統的系統，再裝

cues.en: that we want to run, like an app or a website.
cues.zh: 要執行的應用或網站。

cues.en: Then we might have another EC2 instance and install another guest operating system, well, a guest operating system on that EC2 instance, and then run another application there.
cues.zh: 另一個 EC2 也有客體系統，執行另一應用。

cues.en: And then somebody else might have their EC2 instance on the same hardware, install a guest operating system and app, run their application.
cues.zh: 其他人也可能在同硬體有 EC2，裝系統、執行應用。

cues.en: So that's how virtualization works in a nutshell.
cues.zh: 這是虛擬化概觀。

cues.en: We've discussed this previously and it's a great approach, but this approach does have quite a significant drawback, and that is that these operating systems
cues.zh: 之前討論過，很好，但有顯著缺點，這些作業系統

cues.en: require heavy resource usage.
cues.zh: 非常耗資源。

cues.en: And that is not ideal, because as we can see, we just basically, we just wanna run the applications and we want them to be separated from each other
cues.zh: 不理想，因為其實只想執行應用，讓它們彼此隔離，

cues.en: or from anybody else that might be sharing the same hardware.
cues.zh: 也和共用硬體的其他人隔離。

cues.en: And we don't really need a huge, massive mammoth of an operating system taking up our resources on the EC2 instance.
cues.zh: 不需要龐大作業系統佔 EC2 資源。

cues.en: So that's where containerization comes in for us to help us out.
cues.zh: 容器化可以幫忙。

cues.en: So this is what it looks like.
cues.zh: 長這樣。

cues.en: Again, we have the hardware, the host operating system, then we have a container runtime, and on top of that, we will launch containers,
cues.zh: 同樣硬體、主機系統，再是容器執行環境，上面啟動容器，

cues.en: which contain our application.
cues.zh: 內含應用。

cues.en: So basically we take our application and we put it into this containerized environment.
cues.zh: 把應用放進容器化環境。

cues.en: So it's effectively, like, you can think of it as like a mini tiny operating system, just the essentials,
cues.zh: 可以把它比喻為微型作業系統，只保留必需，

cues.en: just what is necessary for that application to run.
cues.zh: 只含執行應用需要的內容。

cues.en: It's basically just a shell surrounding our application.
cues.zh: 基本上就是應用外的一層殼。

cues.en: And it is very low resource usage.
cues.zh: 資源用量很低。

cues.en: It is much more efficient with resources than the guest operating system, because it has only the essentials that are necessary to run our application.
cues.zh: 比客體系統有效率，只保留執行所需。

cues.en: And one of the most popular containerization platforms is Docker, but there are other ones like Kubernetes, for example.
cues.zh: Docker 是最熱門容器化平台之一，講者也舉 Kubernetes 為其他相關平台。

cues.en: So you will be hearing Docker quite a lot.
cues.zh: 所以經常聽到 Docker。

cues.en: And basically that's what allows us to encapsulate our application and then deploy it in this container runtime.
cues.zh: 它能封裝應用，在容器執行環境部署。

cues.en: And that way we can deploy multiple applications on the same hardware, much more so than in the case of virtualization.
cues.zh: 同硬體可部署比虛擬化更多的應用。

cues.en: Another important thing to note about these containers is that they are portable.
cues.zh: 另一點，容器可攜。

cues.en: You can move them from one environment to a different environment as long as the runtime is supported by that environment where you're moving them to, to the server that you're moving to.
cues.zh: 可移到不同環境，只要目標環境、伺服器支援執行環境。

cues.en: As long as the runtime is supported, your container will run and your application will run seamlessly, it won't change, it'll be running the same way
cues.zh: 支援的話，容器與應用能無縫執行，和其他

cues.en: as it would be running on any other server where that runtime is supported, and that's another huge advantage.
cues.zh: 支援環境的伺服器上完全相同。

cues.en: So the two main benefits of containerizations are they are very low resource usage.
cues.zh: 兩項主要優點，首先資源用量低。

cues.en: So you can deploy many more containers or many more applications on the same hardware as opposed to in the case of virtualization.
cues.zh: 相比虛擬化，同硬體可部署更多容器、應用。

cues.en: And the second one is that containers are portable and can be run anywhere else where the host system supports the runtime.
cues.zh: 第二可攜，可在支援執行環境的主機執行。

cues.en: So that's what containerization is in a nutshell.
cues.zh: 這是容器化概觀。

cues.en: Here's a quick summary of what we discussed.
cues.zh: 這裡快速整理。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
